title: POST /api/radio/command (request); response, parser tool calls, transcribe in $defs
description: Phone -> radio. Pipeline: POST /api/radio/transcribe (audio) -> {text}; POST /api/radio/command {text} -> parser (OpenAI tool calling with tools from Parser.tools_schema(), regex/fuzzy fallback) -> ToolCall[] -> Radio.execute -> actions + radio replies (also broadcast on /ws/radio). Errors from any route are {"error": detail} with the HTTP status (400 empty command; 502/503 STT).

text.description: Operator words (STT output or typed). Must be non-empty after strip.

parser.description: llm when OpenAI returned tool calls, else regex.

truck_id.description: Truck id, excavator id or null (Control).

TruckRef.description: Truck id or 'all'. An empty list means: dispatch picks an idle truck (stop/status/return_to_parking: all trucks).

ExcOne.description: Excavator to go to / load at; 'nearest' = nearest digging excavator (else nearest). Overrides site / from_site with that excavator's face.

SiteRef.description: world.json site id (the LLM is given an enum of ids; regex may also resolve names/aliases).

ToolCall.description: One parsed intent {name, args}. go_to/haul/return_to_parking/stop/status act on trucks; dig/hold/exc_status on excavators. exc_status is produced by the regex parser only (not offered to the LLM). 'hold' targets excavators, not trucks (use stop for trucks).

GoToArgs.description: Send trucks to a site (or an excavator's face load point) and stop there. Parking -> treated as return_to_parking (own slot).

HaulArgs.description: Haul cycle: load at an ore face, dump at crusher or dump, repeat. Defaults: from_site = truck's last face or first ore site; to_site = crusher; loads null = continuous.

Action.description: What Radio.execute did for one tool call (trucks/excavators already resolved to ids).

args.description: Tool args minus trucks; haul is filled in with resolved from_site/to_site/loads.

route_m.description: Road route length of the last truck's first leg.

TranscribeRequest.description: POST /api/radio/transcribe, multipart/form-data, field 'audio' (webm/ogg/m4a/wav/mp3). ElevenLabs Scribe, else OpenAI whisper; 503 when neither key is set.

note.description: 'recording too short' when < 800 bytes (then text is '').

ReleaseResponse.description: POST /api/radio/release: clears every truck job and holds every excavator.
